name: Confusion
source:
Confusion is the story of a transgender girl with a problem. Alex has few friends, a lot of enemies, and even her foster family disrespects her. How will she learn to cope? Should she leave?  Should she finish transitioning? Should she learn to fight back against those who would mean her harm? Will she ever love or be loved in return? End her confusion...

[From [url=https://avnsnax.itch.io/confusion]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《困惑》讲述了一个有问题的跨性别女孩的故事。亚历克斯的朋友很少，敌人很多，甚至她的寄养家庭也不尊重她。她将如何学会应对？她应该离开吗？她应该完成变性吗？她是否应该学会反击那些想要伤害她的人？她会爱或被爱作为回报吗？结束她的迷茫……

[来自[url=https://avnsnax.itch.io/confusion]Itch.io[/url]]
